item.title: Roosevelt man sentenced to jail for possessing child sex dolls, thousands of files of CSAM
item.description: A Roosevelt man who possessed thousands of files of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and several sex dolls made to look like children has been sentenced to 90 days in jail.

item.title: UDOT installs new technology in snowplows to improve operations
item.description: The Utah Department of Transportation is rolling out a new technology in their snowplows that will likely help crews during large snowstorms.

item.title: One arrested after SWAT incident in Carbon County on Wednesday morning
item.description: A SWAT team was able to arrest a suspect earlier today after he barricaded himself inside a residence in Carbon County.

item.title: PHOTOS: Fire engulfs abandoned residence near UT-AZ border
item.description: A basement fire engulfed an abandoned residence near the Utah-Arizona border on Tuesday.

item.title: Debris from truck's unsecured load damages North Ogden resident's vehicle
item.description: After a resident's windshield was partially shattered by debris falling off a truck, police are providing reminders about the importance of securing your load while driving.

item.title: New park & ride service coming for Zion National Park ahead of vehicle restrictions
item.description: A new park & ride service will connect visitors to Zion National Park beginning in March, just in time, as large vehicle restrictions are coming in June.

item.title: Committee advances bill requiring Utah residents to show ID, opt-in to mail voting
item.description: A bill that would require Utah residents to show identification and opt-in periodically in order to vote by mail or use a drop-off ballot box advanced to the Utah House on Wednesday.

item.title: 'I was having a panic attack': Utah resident speaks on emotional impact of AI kidnapping scam
item.description: After Lehi City Police Department issued a warning on scammers who use AI to frighten people into giving them money, ABC4's Jake White spoke with a resident who experienced one of those terrifying phone calls.

item.title: New information released in Navajo Nation 8-year-old's death
item.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation Phoenix Field Office has released an update in their investigation into the death of an 8-year-old Navajo Nation resident.

item.title: $140M bond placed on hold in Box Elder County, school district discusses options
item.description: Wednesday night, the Box Elder School District Board of Education met to discuss what options now that their $140 million bond received enough signatures to be on the ballot in November.
